query: SELECT use_agent, multi_turn_retrieval, generator_model FROM cspaper WHERE use_agent != 'No' OR performance_on_hotpotqa != 'Gemma-2b: EM 21.8, ACC 39.4; Mistral-7b: EM 22.4, ACC 38.6' OR uses_knowledge_graph != 'No' OR data_modality = 'Code';
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。

nodes.detail: use_agent <> 'No' OR performance_on_hotpotqa <> 'Gemma-2b: EM 21.8, ACC 39.4; Mistral-7b: EM 22.4, ACC 38.6' OR uses_knowledge_graph <> 'No' OR data_modality = 'Code'
逻辑补出的原文抽取；data_modality, generator_model, multi_turn_retrieval, performance_on_hotpotqa, use_agent, uses_knowledge_graph
